bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
src=d611f2d4edf8414c21ecd1d43336debfe48319b1
target="$HOME/.local/share/gace-create-videobot/sticker-poll-$src"
test -f "$target/src/runtime/main.mjs" || { echo STK04_STAGE_MAIN_MISSING; exit 61; }
test -f "$target/src/runtime/creatorPollingMain.mjs" || { echo STK04_STAGE_POLL_MISSING; exit 62; }
test -f "$target/src/runtime/creatorPollingConsumer.mjs" || { echo STK04_STAGE_CONSUMER_MISSING; exit 63; }
test -f "$target/src/runtime/creatorMigrate.mjs" || { echo STK04_STAGE_MIGRATE_MISSING; exit 64; }
build_log="$(mktemp /tmp/gace-vdobot-fresh.XXXXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -f "$build_log"' EXIT
if ! docker build --no-cache --network host --pull=false \
 -f "$target/deploy/Dockerfile" -t create-videobot:poll-fresh "$target" >"$build_log" 2>&1;then
 echo STK04_FRESH_IMAGE_BUILD_FAILED
 grep -Ei 'failed|error|unavailable|timeout' "$build_log" | tail -n 4 | sed -E 's#https?://[^ ]+#URL_REDACTED#g' || true
 exit 65
fi
docker run --rm --network none --pull never --entrypoint /bin/sh create-videobot:poll-fresh -c '
test -f /opt/videobot/src/runtime/main.mjs &&
test -f /opt/videobot/src/runtime/creatorPollingMain.mjs &&
test -f /opt/videobot/src/runtime/creatorPollingConsumer.mjs &&
test -f /opt/videobot/src/runtime/creatorMigrate.mjs &&
test -d /opt/videobot/node_modules/pg' >/dev/null || { echo STK04_FRESH_IMAGE_SOURCE_INCOMPLETE; exit 66; }
docker run --rm --network none --pull never --entrypoint node create-videobot:poll-fresh -e \
 "import('./src/runtime/creatorPollingMain.mjs').then(()=>process.exit(0)).catch(()=>process.exit(1))" \
 >/dev/null || { echo STK04_FRESH_IMAGE_IMPORT_FAILED; exit 67; }
test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Config.User}}' create-videobot:poll-fresh)" = node || { echo STK04_FRESH_USER_INVALID; exit 68; }
echo STK04_FRESH_IMAGE_SOURCE_IMPORT=PASS
name=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
token="$(docker inspect -f '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "/run/secrets/videobot_telegram_token"}}{{.Source}}{{end}}{{end}}' "$name")"
dbpass="$(docker inspect -f '{{range .Mounts}}{{if eq .Destination "/run/secrets/videobot_db_password"}}{{.Source}}{{end}}{{end}}' "$name")"
test -f "$token" && test -f "$dbpass" || { echo STK04_SECRET_MOUNT_UNAVAILABLE; exit 69; }
pg="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ei '(^|[-_])postgres([-_]|$)' || true)"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$pg" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 70
user="$(docker exec "$pg" sh -c 'printf %s "$POSTGRES_USER"')"
net="$(docker inspect -f '{{range $k,$v := .NetworkSettings.Networks}}{{println $k}}{{end}}' "$pg" | sed '/^$/d')"
test -n "$user" && test "$net" = deploy_default || exit 71
other="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ei 'create-videobot|createvdobot|videobot-poll|videobot-telegram' | grep -Fxv "$name" || true)"
test -z "$other" || { echo STK04_OTHER_CREATOR_RUNNING; exit 72; }
export VIDEOBOT_TELEGRAM_TOKEN_SOURCE="$token" VIDEOBOT_DB_PASSWORD_SOURCE="$dbpass" GSERVER_POSTGRES_USER="$user" GSERVER_POSTGRES_NETWORK="$net"
docker image tag create-videobot:local-poll create-videobot:poll-rollback
docker image tag create-videobot:poll-fresh create-videobot:local-poll
docker compose -p gace-createvdobot -f "$target/deploy/compose.videobot.poll.yaml" up -d --no-build --force-recreate videobot-poll >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo STK04_RECREATE_FAILED; exit 73; }
sleep 10
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$name" 2>/dev/null)" = true || { echo STK04_FRESH_NOT_RUNNING; exit 74; }
docker logs --tail 100 "$name" 2>&1 | grep -q '^CREATOR_DM_POLL_READY=PASS$' || { echo STK04_FRESH_NOT_READY; exit 75; }
echo STK04_CREATOR_DM_READY=PASS
